class.name: franka_rt_controllers/RtVelocityBlenderController
class.description: Real-time velocity blending controller for Franka FR3. Subscribes to tracking and avoidance velocity topics, blends them in the 1 kHz RT loop with optional rate limiting, smooth timeout ramp, and a single final velocity clamp. Eliminates sample-and-hold jitter caused by non-RT Python blenders publishing at lower rates.
